question: Which dynasty’s king was the first ruler to issue gold coins on a large scale in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Kushan:**

 
 
• The Kushan dynasty was the first to issue gold coins on a large scale in India.
 
• Kanishka, the most famous Kushan ruler, issued a large number of gold coins, which were widely circulated.
 
• These coins reflected the prosperity of the Kushan Empire.
